payload.reason: The evidence indicates that in the UCCA scheme, nodes can be classified as either terminal or non-terminal, but not both simultaneously, as they represent different types of semantic units.

claims.text: In the UCCA scheme, a node can be either a terminal or a non-terminal, but not both at the same time.
Non-terminal nodes in UCCA represent units comprising more than one word, while terminal nodes correspond to individual tokens.
